aiExplanation.summary: This provider coordinates the CZaza Notes webview, current Store, editor state, and user actions.
aiExplanation.detail:
- openUserSectionNoteEditor: Opens an existing Section or presents a new range as an in-memory draft.
- saveSectionNoteDraft: Validates the source snapshot and persists only a non-empty saved draft.
- cancelSectionNoteDraft: Discards an unsaved draft without changing the Note Store.
- runNotesGeneration, runSectionNoteGeneration, and runLineNoteGeneration: Preserve the selected Team or Personal Store for AI tasks.
